title: A Farce of Persuasion
paragraphs: “I’ve taken him down countless times, and thanks to the information from the Dragon Emperor’s Core Stone, I know Raildia’s attack patterns inside and out—no matter how he tries to dodge them. So if I get close enough, I can take control of Gaelion. I set the trap on a hunch, but I never imagined it would actually happen.”
I never would have imagined that my Rival would take control of Takt’s dragon.
“So, Spear Hero, as I mentioned earlier, he’s regained quite a bit of his strength—how’s he doing?”
“Do I really need to tell you!?”
“If he’s that much better, then I guess you don’t have to. Um… judging from Raildia’s memories and the date… I think it’s around the time of the second wave in Melromarc, but what do you think?”
“You figured it out, didn’t you! But the wave has already ended.”
“Huh. So, is Naofumi in this world the wild type? Or is he the gentle Naofumi?”
“I don’t need to tell you that!”
Are you planning to go after Father’s virginity again?
“You don’t have to tell me? Because of you, my precious Filo might—”

Ugh!? Eeeeeek!? A wave of terror is welling up from the depths of my heart. At the same time, the image of my kind Father popped into my mind. For now, I’ll focus on remembering my kind Father to regain my composure.

Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father -san, Filo-tan, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father, Father
As I was trembling uncontrollably, my Rival let out a sigh.

“You still haven’t completely overcome it, have you…? Look, it’ll make things a lot easier down the line if you talk to Gaelion, the Spear Hero. Go talk to Gaelion—he’s the one listening to Naofumi’s requests.”
Dammit… that Rival! Just because I’m weakened doesn’t mean you can keep looking down on me like this! As I was seething inside, my Rival looked up at the sky and said,

“It looks like the Spear Hero is alone—Yuki, Sakura, and Kou aren’t here. And since Naofumi isn’t nearby either, I’d say they’re somewhere in the middle of a loop. Most likely… now that Naofumi and the others have a little breathing room, they’re trying to use Raildia as a sacrificial lamb to kill Takt in a brutal way, aren’t they?”
How on earth can this guy deduce the answer just from my situation?!
“Y-you’re right.”
“Well then, Spear Hero, I’m going to help you figure out if you can make it through this, and I’ll help you take down Takt, so lay your cards on the table.”
Ugh… Rival. And here he is, acting all like my guardian angel.
“W-well, I guess I have no choice.”

Reluctantly, I explained a bit of the situation to my Rival. I told him that the loop began midway through the first world, just before the second wave, where I met Fleon-chan, and that I’d managed to overcome her crisis and solidify my footing.
“Ah, so the Spear Hero’s first Filolial really was assassinated, huh?”
“That’s right! That Crimson Swine! I’m definitely going to kill him in the most gruesome way possible! I’m taking action right now to make that happen! Don’t you dare do anything to mess this up!”

“I’m not telling you not to kill him. I get the gist of the situation now. Well… if that’s the case, it seems like it’ll be okay even if we cut some corners, and I’m glad Naofumi and Filo don’t seem to be worried.”
Ugh… Don’t keep saying “Filo-tan”! It’s bringing back those fears.
“Make sure to protect Naofumi and the others properly.”
“I’ll do that even without being told.”
“Well, in this loop, the worst-case scenario doesn’t seem likely. Still, be careful.”
Ugh… When it comes to this matter, I can’t hold a candle to Rival.
“Ah… Father, who selflessly sacrificed himself for my sake and gave his life to my Rival—I thank you for your mercy…”

I offer a prayer of gratitude to my father, who went to Siltvelt with me and even saved Shieldfreeden. It was my fault—I was a fool who failed to understand your mercy and the actions you took for my sake. Regret comes after the fact, and it’s called regret precisely because it’s irreversible. Will there ever come a time when I can meet my Father from that loop again…?
“That’s a pretty harsh thing to say!”
My rival says that with a slightly embarrassed look on his face! I mean, don’t be embarrassed!
“Now then, Spear Hero. Here, Gaelion is going to give you a good idea on how to make Takt suffer. This is a fact I’ve learned from Raildia’s memories and the Dragon Emperor’s Core Stones so far.”
“What is it?”

“Takt and the others must have appeared before Naofumi and the Spear Hero in various loops so far. Among those, if you think about it carefully, there are times when they didn’t show up or didn’t meet you. I’ll tell you the reason why.”
“Don’t keep us in suspense.”
“Heh heh, listen carefully. Takt—”

And so, Rival went on to explain exactly what Takt would do next. At the same time, he kept goading me relentlessly. Hearing what Takt had been up to while my Father was struggling made my blood boil even more.
“So, Spear Hero, what do you think about going with Gaelion’s proposal…?”
“I’ll be joining in on the execution, too.”
“Of course. Well, until then, Spear Hero, you’d better focus on sorting out your own troubles and improving Naofumi and the others’ standing. Save the fun for later, you know.”

I had a vague feeling I was being manipulated by my Rival, and I really wanted to refuse, but since the plan involved subjecting Takt to a variety of gruesome and diverse forms of torment, I decided to go along with it. So, I left the rest to my Rival and decided to leave Faubrey without finishing Takt off.
After all that, I returned to Melromarc Castle and waited patiently until something happened.

Before long, knights from the Three Heroes Church arrived at the castle with a projection crystal in hand to report. I was summoned to the throne room and shown footage of my Father taking my Finacée hostage.
“What! Oh… Melty! You devil in a shield! Are you saying you’re going to take my family away again? I absolutely won’t let that happen!”
Just as the Trash finished watching the footage and was about to jump to his feet—
“Bububuhi!”
The Crimson Swine placed a hand on the Trash’s shoulder as he tried to stand and said:
“Oink-oink-oink… oink-oink… oink, oink-oink.”

If I recall correctly… “Dad, if the king who holds absolute power over Melromarc leaves the castle, it’ll play right into the Shield Hero’s hands. Since we don’t know what might happen—just like with Seaetto—please leave this to Lord Motoyasu, the Heroes, and me, and just wait here. 'No matter what happens, I’ll rescue Melty from the Shield,’ or something like that.”
Seaetto… who is that? I feel like I’ve heard that name before…

Oh? It feels like my father—who sacrificed himself to Rival for my sake in my mind—whispered that it was about Éclair. I see—so that was Éclair’s last name. Come to think of it, that’s where I caught a brief mention of Éclair’s family of origin.

By the way, as for why Éclair’s father was in his own territory while the queen was away, the story goes that when the castle served a dish of rare fish to celebrate the Crimson Swine’s return from Faubrey, Trash threw a tantrum and forcibly sent him back to the territory to fetch it.

Apparently, Big Sister’s Big Sister was also involved in the details of these events, and that’s what led to the decision to go deep-sea fishing. According to her Father from the first world, it was all part of the Crimson Swine’s covert operations. Since it was a time of peace, Éclair’s father apparently left the castle empty, thinking it would only be for a few days.
Similarly, Big Sister’s parents apparently left the fishing operations in the hands of Big Sister’s older sister. I hear she deeply regrets this now.
“However…”
“Bubuhi! Bubu… Bububu!”

“Hmm… It’s true that the Shield has grown stronger and managed to weather the storm… but yes. The enemy must have been weakened to the point of being on the verge of being defeated by the Three Heroes… If that’s the case, the Heroes should be able to defeat the Demon King! I’ll leave it to you! Go summon the other Heroes—except for Lord Kitamura—right now!”
And so, it seems Trash, riding the Crimson Swine, has decided to leave everything up to us.
“Oink… Oink… Oink!”
Furthermore, a pig who appears to be a nun from the Three Heroes Church is speaking to Trash.
“What? The Shield Demon King is using his mind-control powers and has already brainwashed some of the citizens…? That’s certainly possible for the Shield. Issue a warning immediately!”

And well, from there on, the story just kept getting more and more exaggerated. When I first encountered this incident in the first world, I thought, “The Crimson Swine’s sister? And her Father was kidnapped?” I had actually convinced myself that, if it were her Father, it might indeed be possible. What’s more, seeing the reactions of the soldiers who asked my Father to take command during the second wave, I found myself nodding in agreement—thinking it might actually make sense that he possessed the power of mind control.
Looking back now, it’s obvious that the whole thing was a complete farce. Anyway, due to these circumstances, Ren and Itsuki were recalled. But…
“You’re telling me we can’t track down the Sword Heroes or Bow Heroes!?”

“Yes! The Sword Hero left his subordinates in charge of the inn and went out alone, after which his whereabouts became unknown… and the Bow Hero also suddenly vanished, leaving his companions behind…”
“Grr… Don’t tell me you’re suggesting this is the work of the Shield Demon too!”
“You’re reading way too much into this.”

I won’t stand for my Father being blamed for why Ren and Itsuki haven’t been captured at this point! In my head, my Father from the first world is shouting, “It’s definitely your fault!” but that’s not true! Fleon-chan and Black Thunder are protecting Ren and Itsuki, so they’re absolutely safe. What’s more, I’ve thoroughly instructed these two on how to awaken the Hero’s power and how to strengthen themselves, so as long as Ren and Itsuki just listen carefully, their safety should be fully ensured!
“Ren and Itsuki probably have their own thoughts about that last battle. They might just be training in secret without telling their comrades because they feel responsible.”
“But! Every moment counts right now!”
Trash looks anxious, thinking about his Finacée.
“Don’t worry. I’ll go find Naofumi for you.”
I say this, even though I don’t really mean it.
“Bubuhi-bububu, bububu”
Then, perhaps finding it convenient, the Crimson Swine was busy soothing Trash.
“Hmm… Contact Lord Amaki and Lord Kawasumi immediately and order them to take down the Shield! Understood!”

That’s what Trash ordered his soldiers. And so, we ended up chasing my Father along the streets of the First World. To be honest, we already know the route he’s taking to escape. However, we had to pretend the search was going badly. That’s why I kept leading the Crimson Swine and his crew to search the wrong places over and over again.
A few days have passed. If we’re on the path of the first world, it should be about the time Father is passing along the border.
“Yes… According to what our shadow reconnaissance has uncovered, it appears the Shield Hero’s party is near the northeastern border.”
“Bubuhi, bububu.”
My Father’s whereabouts have been exposed by a report from the Three Heroes Church’s spies.
“Even without Lord Itsuki, we’ll join forces to rescue Princess Melty! Kill the Shield Demon!”
“Ooh!”

And for some reason, even Itsuki’s companions have joined forces with the Crimson Swine. Smoked Meat looks like his eyes are burning with desire. I wonder if his plan is to secure his position in Itsuki’s party by taking down my Father and claiming the credit?
“Bububuhi! Buhi Buhi”
The Crimson Swine is making some kind of noise… but it’s a huge nuisance. I’ll have to stroke the feathers of Filolial-sama—whom I’m using as a means of transportation—to calm my mind.

…Come to think of it, what’s become of Yuki-chan and Kou? If I recall correctly, Yuki-chan’s egg should be gone by now. Still, since I know which farm Yuki-chan has been entrusted to, it might be nice to go visit her if I get the chance.

Kou has been at that farm the whole time. Since he gets along well with my Big Sister and the Elephant, it might be nice to bring him here once this is all over. Just as I was thinking that, the Crimson Swine started setting up checkpoints, just like in the first world.
“…Oink?”
The Lazy Pig is tilting its head at me, but I couldn’t care less.
“There he is! That straw cart over there!”
The one on lookout pointed at the straw-laden cart being pulled by Filo-tan. My father pushed the straw aside and revealed himself.
“Is Motoyasu the only one here?”
“I have no obligation to tell you that!”
That Smoked Meat guy is just blurting things out on his own. He’s so noisy. I could dispose of a guy like you right this instant!
“You Shield Devil! Hurry up and release Second Princess Melty!”
The Smoked Meat guy is parroting what Itsuki said. Just as you’d expect from one of Itsuki’s subordinates. At this stage, it seems they’re thinking along the same lines.
“Release? I’m not holding the Second Princess captive in the first place.”
“Don’t be so disingenuous. We’ve got proof!”
“That’s right. You have no sense of justice!”
“Justice… really?”
I can sense the exasperated look on my Father’s face. It’s a complete farce, after all. What a total letdown.
Sword… 14%  Bow… 25%
